description: Preflights the official Texas Active Franchise Taxpayers dataset and can transform an explicitly approved operator-supplied file into immutable local-review-only staging artifacts. Network row acquisition and publication remain default-denied and unimplemented.
redirect_policy: Reject redirects. Permit only exact HTTPS requests to /api/views/9cir-efmm with no query and /resource/9cir-efmm.json with the sole count(*) query; row-returning queries are forbidden.
retry: Retry only transient transport failures, HTTP 429, and HTTP 5xx with bounded backoff. Do not retry redirects, other 4xx responses, host/path/query drift, schema drift, identity drift, missing license status, invalid counts, cancellation, or an absent/incorrect large-acquisition acknowledgement.
checkpoint: Persist an optional immutable preflight receipt. For an explicitly acknowledged operator-supplied offline file, create a collision-safe UUID run only under .staging with an internal selected-source snapshot, 16 normalized organization partitions, quarantine, optional exact-ID links, administrative ZIP evidence, summary, and verified manifest. Never create current.json, a releases entry, registry/coverage output, or Heatmap input.
idempotency: The dataset ID, catalog rowsUpdatedAt timestamp, exact 18-field schema fingerprint, and count-only result identify one observed preflight state; the receipt also carries its independent SHA-256 digest.
cancellation: Abort metadata/count requests and offline parsing/reconciliation/verification cooperatively. A cancelled offline run may retain incomplete files only inside its uniquely named .staging diagnostic directory; it never creates a release pointer or publishes an artifact.
retention_profile: Retain immutable metadata/count preflight receipts. If a future separately authorized row acquisition is implemented, raw records remain internal and normalized record-level records remain local-review-only until explicit rights and privacy review permits broader use.
